material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards

material_news_signals.body_text: the new england patriots prized offseason acquisition will be sidelined for the next month new england is placing receiver a j brown on injured reserve after he suffered an ankle injury in wednesday s season opening loss to seattle espn s adam schefter reported the roster move will prevent brown from playing for at least four games before he is eligible to return from ir the patriots next four games are home vs pittsburgh and jacksonville and buffalo before a week 5 home game vs las vegas nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on thursday that an mri confirmed that brown suffered a high ankle sprain early in the second half of wednesday s game high ankle sprains typically have a recovery time of about four to six weeks brown suffered the injury when his foot was trapped awkwardly between the turf and a seahawks defender while attempting to make a third down catch a three time pro bowler with six 1 000 yard seasons in seven years brown was traded from philadelphia to new england in a june blockbuster deal that netted new england s 2028 first round pick and a 2027 fifth round selection the move reunited brown with his first nfl head coach mike vrabel who directed brown in his first few years in tennessee brown s arrival provided the patriots with an unquestioned no 1 receiver with star power and big play potential an element new england lacked during its run to super bowl lx in 2025 with brown on the roster the nfl s third ranked offense was expected to be even more productive in 2026 instead quarterback drake maye and the patriots will have to manage without brown for at least next month

material_news_signals.headline: NFL Network: Patriots WR A.J. Brown suffered high ankle sprain, expected to miss at least four weeks
material_news_signals.description: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown (ankle) was ruled out of Wednesday's Kickoff Game against the Seattle Seahawks.
material_news_signals.body_text: a j brown s much ballyhooed debut with the new england patriots came to an abrupt conclusion wednesday night brown injured his ankle early in the third quarter and was ruled out of the nfl kickoff game which the patriots lost to the host seattle seahawks 13 10 the new england receiver suffered a high ankle sprain an mri confirmed on thursday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported brown is expected to miss at least four weeks according to rapoport which is standard with high ankle sprains the three time pro bowl wide receiver went for a low throw from drake maye with seahawks cornerback nehemiah pritchett defending and deflecting the ball pritchett s knee came down on brown s right ankle and the wideout immediately grabbed the ankle brown who was playing in his first game for the pats since he was acquired in an offseason trade from the philadelphia eagles was attended to on the field before limping off to the blue tent he was then accompanied by trainers to the locker room where he underwent x rays prior to his exit brown had three receptions on four targets for 26 yards all of those numbers team highs at the time his biggest contribution was drawing a massive 34 yard pass interference penalty that put the pats on the seahawks 2 yard line to set up the game s opening score brown 29 has played in at least 13 games in each of his seven nfl seasons but he has missed at least two games in each of his last two with philadelphia

local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an material_news_signals.body_text: jim leonhard has spent his life chasing things beyond his reach the buffalo bills 39 new defensive coordinator was a maybe 5 foot 8 kid from tony wis population 105 his teensy high school has gotten tinier since he left and now plays eight man football leonhard amassed every accolade you could imagine at flambeau high he broke records was voted captain earned all state recognition in three sports was named all academic struck out 19 batters in a seven inning game and won slam dunk competitions a no scholarship college star an undrafted nfl keystone an entry level assistant coach who skyrocketed to national prominence within a year leonhard 39 s pursuit of excellence has defied all who 39 ve wondered if he truly had what it took 34 part of what comes with being in a small town is knowing there 39 s always bigger and better out there 34 leonhard said 34 i always had my eyes on that i don 39 t know what it is but i 39 ve got to go find it 34 so i didn 39 t compare myself to anybody in this little world i was in i knew there was more i wanted to go compete let 39 s go chase the guy that you 39 re not seeing 34 he received zero division i scholarship offers because he 39 s small leonhard walked onto the university of wisconsin football team played as a true freshman led the country in interceptions as a sophomore and became a three time all american but the nfl didn 39 t draft him because he 39 s small yet he stuck for 10 years with the bills new york jets baltimore ravens denver broncos and cleveland browns through guile he was a valuable commodity nfl coaches rex ryan and mike pettine relied on him not only to run their defenses but also to interpret them for his teammates those traits translated directly to coaching one year into the vocation wisconsin promoted him to defensive coordinator his units routinely ranked among the top five nationally in total defense before he turned 40 he 39 d spurned an offer from the green bay packers and interest from university of alabama coach nick saban in 2022 wisconsin hired a new coach passing over leonhard a move badgers fans lament leonhard dominated his next transition too joining the denver broncos and quickly establishing himself as a rising nfl coaching star now the bills are counting on him to help deliver what has remained beyond their reach a super bowl championship to learn about how leonhard has defied expectations throughout his life nbsp the athletic spoke to his mentors teammates and admirers leonhard was such an afterthought as a wisconsin freshman in 2001 that his name didn 39 t appear in the media guide the next year still without a scholarship he was wisconsin 39 s first sophomore since 1947 to be named team mvp paul chryst former wisconsin coach jim 39 s story is legendary on that campus everybody knows it barry alvarez former wisconsin football coach and athletics director i 39 ll never forget the first day in freshman camp i told our secondary coach 34 have that leonhard kid work with the second unit 34 he said 34 who are you talking about 34 i said 34 the little guy who gets his hands on every goddamn ball that 39 s thrown 34 leonhard there was a lot i had to learn but i got to be a backup and played special teams that success helped elevate me to the next step alvarez when he shows up he 39 s not very imposing not real impressive but you can 39 t deny his athletic ability he ran a 4 4 in the 40 yard dash we would have dunk contests and he would stuff the basketball any way you wanted it leonhard halfway through camp my sophomore year the starter decided to transfer from that point it wasn 39 t necessarily a blur but everything happened really fast i had a great spring and earned a lot of respect from the coaches ryan who coached leonhard with the ravens jets and bills he was an all american and led in interceptions and punt returns that didn 39 t come by luck leonhard was voted first team all america three times yet went undrafted in 2005 the bills signed him as a rookie free agent pettine who coached leonhard on ryan 39 s staffs and as browns head coach you didn 39 t think this was a guy who could start at safety for you you thought he was going to do your taxes ryan it 39 s hard to recognize a player like that because you 39 ve got to be able to have confidence in your eyes most scouts miss it because 34 he 39 s not big enough 34 well who 39 s making all the plays who can handle all the pressure darrelle revis hall of fame cornerback and jets teammate if you don 39 t pass the eye test that 39 s one thing remember tom brady 39 s combine photos we 39 ve got to see what kind of player you are between the white lines he proved it every day rod woodson hall of fame defensive back he was a gym rat this was told to me as a rookie in 1987 every player on an nfl roster has talent everybody they are the best out of the best out of the best in the world jim just didn 39 t fit the mold matt bowen former bills safety and special teamer special teams back then was the wild west you had four man wedges on kickoffs and trap blocks if you 39 re going to run down that field on kickoff you 39 re going to hit hard and it 39 s going to hurt jimmy loved doing that stuff john guy former bills vice president of pro personnel everything about him was plus plus plus he had courage dependable reliable he didn 39 t make mistakes he didn 39 t miss tackles bowen he handled himself like a 12 year vet i missed a lot of games with a crack in my fibula to stay mentally involved while i was out i would study third down tendencies of our next opponent and share with the other dbs i 39 m a veteran sitting down to tell this rookie what the patriots do on third and 2 to 6 but he already knew it in 2008 buffalo declined to re sign leonhard after three seasons he landed with baltimore as a deep backup when strong safety dawan landry suffered a career threatening neck injury that september leonhard became the starter on a loaded defense guy his size and some injuries made it tough to keep a player like that over guys you 39 ve drafted we were at the point where we needed so many different things that we could never get it right pettine john harbaugh had just gotten hired by the ravens you get an extra minicamp as a staff before the draft because of a new head coach and we were very light on safeties we needed extra bodies to eat up reps just so we can do 11 on 11 work ryan i remember telling ravens gm ozzie newsome 34 if we want to keep the best players i want this f ing kid right here 34 guy jimmy got a full opportunity in baltimore to carry the load sometimes it takes another opportunity to show what you really got leonhard you sit back and think 34 damn i 39 ve played with some pretty impressive players 34 much of that group is in canton or on their way to canton pettine we had great players that we wanted to take the thinking off their plate you never want to slow a special talent down because he has to process too much information we used the term 34 thinking buddy 34 and jimmy was multiple players 39 34 thinking buddy 34 we told jim 34 if they make a mistake for a mental error that 39 s your fault 34 and he welcomed that ryan he was probably at his best in the biggest games just a clutch player we beat tennessee in the 2008 09 playoffs he forces a couple fumbles and does it all we left that stadium having two tight ends playing defensive end to win the game just beat to s didn 39 t matter that sucker played his ass off the jets hired ryan to be their head coach in 2009 he brought leonhard as a foundational piece revis jim came in with a certain type of leadership from the ravens those guys were winning a lot with ed reed and ray lewis and the way they demand the same type of approach to the game from everybody 133 that 39 s what jim did for us it changes your organization jim o 39 neil defensive assistant with the jets bills and browns i had just got hired by the jets to coach safeties my first year in the nfl now i was coaching a brilliant player who knew the system better than i did ryan i 39 ve been around a lot of damn smart players but having jim was a luxury he 39 s a chess master two steps ahead all the time o 39 neil he was a pain in my ass i always felt like i had to stay one night ahead of him in my prep he challenged me every single day with maybe the toughest scheme questions you could get ryan we had veteran safety kerry rhodes who wanted to call the defense well that lasted about two days jimmy just took it over revis i really loved playing with him his intellect his football iq the way he communicated he was just very tuned in and detailed pettine he 39 s a calming influence he could think clearly in a firestorm ryan when he was in there we were the best defense in the league and it wasn 39 t close leonhard started 30 consecutive games for the jets including playoffs but in a 2010 week 13 practice collision with receiver patrick turner leonhard broke his right shinbone ryan when he got hurt it cost us a super bowl i 39 m convinced of that revis that was a big blow we were really balling out and he was an anchor pettine it happened on a friday we went and lost to the patriots 45 3 we 39 d beaten them already that year and would beat them again a month later in the playoffs but when you lose a guy like jim he brings the value of more than just one person ryan no way in hell we would have been beaten by pittsburgh in the afc championship game had jimmy been healthy as ryan and pettine moved on to other teams they repeatedly brought leonhard with them as an on field lieutenant pettine he was one of those rare players that could provide an understanding of what we were trying to do he truly understood the why o 39 neil he was a great bridge for the coaches to think about things from a player 39 s perspective pettine he wasn 39 t afraid to say 34 hey the guys are a little hung up on this one 34 or 34 you might be overloading the guys with this 34 133 it was a no brainer he was going to coach it was just such a natural thing because he has a gift bowen he loves his craft he 39 s a grinder leonhard retired from playing after the 2014 season he joined wisconsin 39 s staff as a defensive backs coach in 2016 chryst i talked to him to see if he just wanted to be around it get a taste of it leonhard i got into coaching thinking 34 this is year to year let 39 s see how long this lasts 34 i just wanted to go back to madison and help max out what that place could be woodson a former big ten network analyst when he first got the job i thought 34 is that the jim leonhard who played in the nfl 34 i had to google it up 34 that is him 34 i 39 ve been rooting for him as a coach ever since chryst when i had a chance to name a new defensive coordinator in 2017 i felt like jim was everything we needed he had coached only one season but he had so much football experience there wasn 39 t a lot of discussion bowen jimmy 39 s defense at wisconsin was a great study multiple fronts simulated pressures creating numbers advantages in terms of blitzes and coverages taking away what opponents do best pettine when you were evaluating college players you looked forward to getting to watch wisconsin film o 39 neil they were badass wisconsin fired chryst in october 2022 and named leonhard interim head coach for the final seven games wisconsin then hired university of cincinnati coach and longtime ohio state assistant coach luke fickell instead chryst i thought jim was the right one to take over i didn 39 t see the change happening but in that instance it 39 s hard to switch and not care about the good of the team anymore i wanted him to be the next guy absolutely alvarez he had my endorsement leonhard if i 39 d have had the chance i would have made it better i felt like i had the plan the structure the organization set and a plan for a lot of the people so you get really excited about what that could look like and they went in a different direction ryan for them not to give him the wisconsin job is an absolute f ing joke people who know the game know how good he is 133 i 39 m looking forward to him being a head coach in the nfl because that 39 s where he belongs quite frankly he 39 s too smart for the college level he 39 d be wasted there he 39 s destined to be a great one after two seasons as the broncos 39 defensive pass game coordinator new bills coach joe brady hired leonhard to run their defense nbsp ryan right out of the gate he 39 s going to have a huge impact josh allen 39 s my favorite player in the league and i want to see him win some super bowls it 39 s just a great hire bowen no disrespect to the previous coaches in buffalo they won a lot of games but i think the fans are going to love it pettine jim o 39 neil and i have had those discussions we 39 re curious to know what he 39 s going to major in o 39 neil he 39 s rooted in pressure i would be shocked if he just got into a 4 3 defense and played coverage that 39 s not in his dna pettine i think he 39 s going to be conventional on early downs just because of the run threat but as soon as he 39 s free to get a little bit exotic he 39 ll do some fun stuff woodson it will be based on trust and speed a lot of blitzes that will look different rex 39 s defenses are very similar to what we see with minnesota vikings defensive coordinator brian flores today a lot of crazy things jim will bring that life bowen if this defense takes off they 39 re material_news_signals.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards

material_news_signals.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold will undergo MRI; hip fracture ruled out after win over Patriots
material_news_signals.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury on Seattle's first drive Wednesday night against the Patriots and was ruled out and replaced by Drew Lock.
material_news_signals.body_text: the seahawks are breathing a sigh of relief both after a second half comeback victory to open the season and due to the latest update on quarterback sam darnold s health darnold who was ruled out just prior to halftime of wednesday s 13 10 season opening win over the patriots due to a hip injury is still having tests done but a hip fracture has been ruled out head coach mike macdonald said postgame macdonald described the results of darnold s testing as great news though the team still does not know the extent of the qb s injury darnold underwent a ct scan on his hip at the harborview medical center in seattle and received encouraging but inconclusive results per espn s adam schefter who added darnold is scheduled to undergo an mri on thursday darnold suffered his injury during seattle s first drive a five play 30 yard march when he was sacked on third down by dre 39 mont jones trainers did not initially attend to the qb on the sideline but he went to the blue tent during new england s opening possession drew lock then entered the game in relief while darnold limped to the locker room as seattle s offense took the field for a second time darnold was 1 of 2 for 13 yards before sustaining the injury with the seahawks and pats knotted at 0 seattle s offense went silent without darnold the patriots were able to open up a 7 0 lead over the course of the first half as lock proved unable to lead any of his five drives into enemy territory the seahawks became just the third reigning super bowl champion to get shut out in the first half of their season opener joining the 1984 raiders and 1967 packers per nfl research like those raiders and packers teams who recovered for a win and a tie respectively seattle would not lose the defense played tremendously allowing only a field goal the rest of the way and ending all three of new england s fourth quarter possessions with interceptions including an end zone pick by joshua jobe with 21 seconds remaining to seal the victory seattle s smothering defense allowed lock just enough opportunity as the seahawks overcame a double digit deficit with two field goals and a 45 yard touchdown reception by jaxon smith njigba making lock the first backup qb in nfl history to throw a td in a reigning super bowl champion s season opener he was buoyed by the defense s stellar performance but lock protected the ball and showed why he s one of the league s more trusted reserves going 16 of 22 for 187 yards and the aforementioned td it remains to be seen how many games if any darnold will miss but at least for wednesday night the seahawks found a winning formula in his absence

material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition
